english.title: Worker knowingly allow delivery by another on club premises alcohol to under 18 - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who worked in a capacity whether paid or unpaid, on relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLUB PREMISES AND LOCATION..), with the authority to prevent it, knowingly allowed another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to deliver to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON SUPPLIED..), an individual under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..), supplied on those premises by or on behalf of the club to or to the order of a member of the club

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.
The Penalty Notice for Disorder rose from £80 to £90 on 01/07/13

Section 151(6) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides that the above offence does not apply where:-
(a) the alcohol is delivered at a place where the buyer or, as the case may be, person supplied lives or works, or
(b) the individual aged under 18 works on the relevant premises in a capacity, whether paid or unpaid, which involves the delivery of alcohol, or
(c) the alcohol is sold or supplied for consumption on the relevant premises.
